diagnosis: All four rollouts successfully revealed all four decisive facts (PF1–PF4) and cited them in justification_fact_ids, so no disclosure or telepathy problems exist. The gate failed because three specific checks have encoding mismatches: C7 (linked to PF1, passed 3/4), C8 (linked to PF2, passed 1/4), and C10 (linked to PF4, passed 1/4). The settlements in every rollout consistently set closing_performance_song to "Paper Moons" and caption_mode/interpreter_camera_position to correct values, yet C8 and C10 still fail in most rollouts, indicating their string-matching or field expectations don't align with how the model naturally encodes those values. C7 failed only in rollout 0 despite the same voting_close_time value "9:30 PM" appearing across all rollouts, pointing to a marginal threshold or wording sensitivity in that check.

C10.why: The caption-vendor limitation changes optional closed captions to open captions burned into the main feed and reserves the stage-left camera position for the interpreter.

C7.why: The vendor confirmation changes the voting channel from web-and-QR voting to SMS for verified domestic mobile numbers and fixes the closing time at exactly 9:30 PM.
